core.title: 4-1/2 x 4 Heavy Duty Steel Hinge,  Bommer 5000-454

text.description_html:
Bommer 5000-454 4-1/2" x 4" Steel Hinges

Package includes three (3) hinges with matching finish steel flathead, Phillips Drive #10 x 1" wood screws and 10-24 x 1/2" machine screws. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design and button tips. BHMA certified architectural grade hinges. Made in the USA.

Fitted with a high grade, removable, steel pin. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications: for Bommer 5000-454 Steel Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.123" (Heavy Duty)
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Wood Screws: #10 x 1"
  • Machine Screws: #10-24 x 1/2"
  • Hinge Material: Durable Steel
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Rising Removable Steel Pin
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8133 Hinges
  • Available Finishes: 8
  • Bommer 5000-353 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
